checks.a_analysis: The output contains numerous instances of content duplication across multiple sections. In Section 1, the text block beginning with 'The auditor did not encounter any initial barriers...' appears in Element 9 and is repeated in Element 11. In Section 7 (Standard 115.215), the analysis header paragraph is repeated three times as Elements 2, 7, and 10. In Section 21 (Standard 115.272), Elements 10 and 11 repeat the findings text already provided in the table cell of Element 9. In Section 25 (Standard 115.282), Element 11 repeats text from Element 10. Additionally, the paragraph regarding the exit briefing appears at the end of Section 2 and is duplicated as Element 2 in Section 3.
checks.b_evidence_source: The exit briefing was conducted with the Facility Director, Program Supervisor, Associate Warden, Administrative Officer, and the Correctional Sergeant... for development of the final report and completion of the audit.
checks.b_evidence_output: This text block appears at the end of the Section 2 paragraph list and is repeated identically as Element 2 in Section 3.

checks.a_analysis: The heading hierarchy is consistent. H1 is used for the document title, H2 for major sections (Narrative, Phases, Audit Findings), and H3 for sub-headers within the findings. No skips or nesting errors were observed.

Tables are correctly converted. Header rows are identified, and the structural arrangement of columns and rows accurately reflects the source PDF, including complex nested tables used for standard compliance determinations.

The reading order is materially corrupted in Section 1. Text from the top of page 6 (starting with 'probation officer...') appears as Element 10, which is placed after Element 9 containing text from the bottom of page 6 ('The auditor did not encounter any initial barriers...'). This breaks the logical flow of the auditor's description of the pre-audit phase. Furthermore, items from lists are occasionally stranded between unrelated blocks, such as item 7 of the interview list in Standard 115.216 being separated from the rest of the list by a heading.
